name: Haus Pleifer
beschreibung: The Haus Pleifer is situated in the sunny, peaceful hamlet of Falpaus in the municipality of Kaunerberg, set high above the Upper Inn Valley at the mouth of the Kaunertal. The spacious holiday apartment offers top comfort for self-catering guests and families, featuring a fully equipped modern kitchen, warm living and sleeping areas crafted from local timber, and an expansive balcony capturing breathtaking panoramas across the Ötztal Alps and the Kaunergrat Nature Park. In summer, the unspoilt natural landscape invites exploration along historic water irrigation channels and high-altitude trails. In winter, visitors enjoy convenient road access to the family-friendly slopes of Fendels and the snow-sure slopes of the Kaunertal Glacier.
kurzbeschreibung: Peacefully located holiday home in Falpaus on the Kaunerberg featuring comfortable apartments and sweeping views of the Inn Valley.
